content: Yandex SpeechKit v3: RU/EN/TR. Modes streaming, sync (<=30s), async long-audio (billed per second of 2-channel audio, min 15s, ~$0.000020/unit i.e. roughly 0.15-0.9 rub/min tiered). On-premise / hybrid deployment of SpeechKit ML models now offered for sensitive traffic (sovereignty story). YandexGPT via Yandex Foundation Models also exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint (llm.api.cloud.yandex.net/v1).
